newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close lower, bonds stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close lower, bonds stable.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished lower on Monday for the fifth consecutive session, but dealers said rates could rebound on Tuesday.
The overnight interbank rate closed at 5.201 percent against Saturday's 5.264 end, with 30-day commercial paper at 5.10 against 5.10-5.15.
Dealers said payment on Tuesday against T$40 billion in government bonds auctioned last week would tighten liquidity.
Government bond yields were stable in directionless trade.
Dealers said the market would hover in a narrow-range consolidation in the near term.
